whoItsFor: Job seekers who want to run their own search with Claude Code and are comfortable forking a repo and filling in a personal profile. The README notes it is language- and country-agnostic, so it also suits non-Danish markets.
useCases: Evaluate job postings and score how well they fit your profile
Tailor a CV and write a cover letter for each application
Prepare for scheduled interviews with stage-specific prep packs

requirements.runtime: Python 3.10+, Bun, Claude Code, LaTeX distribution with lualatex and xelatex
